items.title: Two arrested on suspicion of burglary at Prince and Princess of Wales's Norfolk home

items.title: Senegal restored as Africa Cup of Nations champions
items.summary: Senegal has been awarded the Africa Cup of Nations title after successfully appealing against the decision to strip them of it.
